question: In the sentence 'His ideas were radical', what is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'radical'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Conservative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Radical"** means relating to or affecting the fundamental nature of something; far-reaching or thorough, often associated with extreme or progressive ideas. (आधारभूत, उग्र)

 
 
• **Example:** His radical approach to education challenged traditional teaching methods.
 
 
 
• **"Conservative"** refers to holding traditional values and being cautious or resistant to change, often the opposite of radical. (रूढ़िवादी)
 
 
• **Example:** Her conservative views on politics often clash with the progressive ideas of her peers.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Radical"** is **"Conservative"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Conservative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Progressive** (प्रगतिशील): Favoring or advocating progress, change, or reform.

 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced progressive policies to address climate change.
 
 
 
• **Extreme** (अत्यधिक): Reaching a high or the highest degree; very intense or excessive.
 
 
• **Example:** His extreme opinions often alienate others in discussions.
 
 
 
• **Innovative** (नवोन्मेषी): Introducing new ideas; original and creative in thinking.
 
 
• **Example:** She designed an innovative solution to reduce energy consumption.
